mission_08: Great work! You have successfully implemented frequency encoding and compared it with label encoding. You learned how to calculate category counts and proportions using value_counts(), map them back to the dataframe, and understand the trade-offs between encoding methods. Frequency encoding is particularly useful when category prevalence carries predictive signal. It produces a single numeric column regardless of cardinality and does not risk data leakage since it does not use the target variable. Combine it with other encodings for a richer feature representation.
